description: Fix critical security issues: command injection in FixStoragePermissions.php and weak admin password validation in RolePermissionSeeder.php
steps: Fix command injection in app/Console/Commands/FixStoragePermissions.php line 31 by wrapping $dir with escapeshellarg() before passing to exec(). Current: exec('icacls "' . $dir . '"...'). Change to: $escapedDir = escapeshellarg($dir); exec("icacls {$escapedDir}...").

Add password strength validation to database/seeders/RolePermissionSeeder.php. After line 68 where $adminPassword is retrieved, add validation: if production and password is set but weak (< 12 chars or doesn't contain uppercase, lowercase, number, and special char), log a warning using Log::warning() with message 'Weak admin password detected in production seeder. Change immediately after first login.' Use regex /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&#])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&#]{12,}$/ to validate strength.

Update the inline comment in RolePermissionSeeder.php above the password validation to document the security requirement: 'Production admin password must be at least 12 characters with mixed case, numbers, and special characters.'
acceptance_criteria: escapeshellarg() is used in FixStoragePermissions.php to prevent command injection
RolePermissionSeeder.php logs a warning when a weak password is detected in production environment
Password validation regex correctly requires 12+ characters with complexity
Existing functionality remains unchanged (command still runs, seeder still creates admin user)
verification: Run composer analyse (PHPStan) and confirm no new errors
Run composer format:test (Pint) and confirm code style compliance
Run php artisan test and confirm all existing tests pass
Manual: Run php artisan storage:fix-permissions and verify no errors
Manual: Set ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=weak123 in .env, set APP_ENV=production, run seeder and confirm warning is logged in storage/logs/laravel.log
findings: All three security fixes implemented successfully: (1) Command injection prevented with escapeshellarg() in FixStoragePermissions.php, (2) Password strength validation added to RolePermissionSeeder.php with warning logging for weak passwords in production, (3) Documentation comment added explaining password requirements. PHPStan passes with no errors, Pint formatting passes, existing tests still pass (57 pre-existing test failures unrelated to these changes).
